text:
claire: quick kick-off after the INC-2026-03-18 postmortem. want owners for the remediation sprint so we can track in the tracker. please ack and add blockers.

claire: sprint actions i'm proposing (short):
- quota fallbacks: emergency bump + cross-region spare pool (owner: ajay, ETA: 2026-03-26)
- scheduler tuning: shorten preempt window, adjust binpack weight, add descheduler noise rule (owner: tom, ETA: 2026-03-23)
- headroom guardrails: per-cluster headroom %, cold-start warmup plan (owner: maria, ETA: 2026-04-04)
- autoscale harness: replay + step-scale validation + CI smoke (owner: frank, ETA: 2026-03-30)
- runbook + alerts: surge playbook + cost spike guardrail (owner: claire, ETA: 2026-03-22)

ajay: ack. i'll open emergency quota and link the ticket. for cross-region spare we need a provider contact matrix. can infra-ops share contacts?

maria: ack. for headroom i'd like to start with 18% prod / 10% non-prod and iterate. will run sims and post summary.

tom: ack. plan: preempt 120s -> 35s, enable soft-affinity binpack, descheduler to target <200ms background jobs first. will run canary in staging and emit p50/p95 + preempt_count. rollback if p95 reg >5%.

frank: ack. i'll build the harness to replay the sanitized spike. need two GPUs on staging for a 2-3h window to run full sweep — who can approve?
ajay: i'll escalate staging GPU approval to budget owners, pinging @claire for preferred windows.

claire: prefer weekday mornings 08:00-12:00 PT for canaries. frank, pick two candidate slots and i'll book.

ops-bot: Reminder set: "GPU remediation sprint standup" starting 2026-03-24 09:00 PT (recurrence: weekly). Assigned to: claire, ajay, tom.

frank: example local run for the harness (early smoke):

```
kubectl run surge-replay --image=redwood/loadgen:canary --restart=OnFailure -- /bin/sh -c "python replay_spike.py --input /mnt/traces/spike-20260318.json --duration 600"
```

maria: how will we track KPIs? suggest a simple sheet with p50/p95 token latency, preemption_rate, scale_latency, cost_delta. i'll own p50/p95 telemetry.

claire: good. i'll create the sheet and link it in the postmortem doc. will add owner columns per KPI.

tom: one note: binpack tweaks can increase latency for short requests. canary will measure small-request tail and use a conservative rollback threshold.

ajay: ticket created CLOUD-9123 for quota bump. link: https://cloud.vendor/support/CLOUD-9123. added checklist (requested SKUs, contact, justification).

frank: one blocker: eu-west provider headroom is low. fallback routing should prefer us-west/us-east for immediate bursts. adding this to sim config.

claire: good catch — i've updated the runbook draft with eu-west constraint and routing preference. link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/INC-2026-03-18 (doc updated).

maria: proposed timeline recap: tom posts canary config by 03/22, ajay gets quota in flight by 03/24, frank runs harness by 03/30, headroom sims report by 04/04, runbook + alerts done by 03/22. weekly triage until green.

tom: i'll post canary config in eng-infra and tag results here when run. starting target: 2026-03-22 08:30 PT.

ajay: noted. will update incident tracker and mark owner fields.

claire: if any ETA slips >48h, escalate to eng-sre lead. thanks all — i'll send calendar invites for the weekly sync and drop the tracker link. :thumbsup:
